items.title: Michi Fuji interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who are the violin players that you — you mentioned Django — I mean Stephane Grappelli, and anybody else you particularly like on violin?

ctx.x: I don’t know. I not so much play with women. I don’t have opportunity. But it’s kind of different. I don’t know why. And harder.
Who are the violin players that you — you mentioned Django — I mean Stephane Grappelli, and anybody else you particularly like on violin?
Stuff Smith, Christian Howes, Ray Nance.
